designRequirements.name: SMD molded inductor 4.0x4.0x3.1 mm, 3.3 uH, buck 12 V -> 3.3 V

manufacturerInfo.name: OpenMagnetics
manufacturerInfo.description: Generic model of a 4.0 x 4.0 x 3.1 mm molded power inductor, 3.3 uH. Body size, height, inductance, DC resistance and pads are published values of such a part; the winding and the core material are not published (see provenance).

part.description: molded power inductor, 4.0 x 4.0 x 3.1 mm case, composite core

provenance.sourceName: published datasheet of a 4.0 x 4.0 x 3.1 mm molded power inductor, 3.3 uH
fields: mechanical (body 4.0 +-0.3 mm square, height 3.1 mm max)
coil connections padWidth 3.25 mm / padDepth 0.82 mm (terminal size)
core shape A = C = body side, B = height

provenance.derivation: Wire INFERRED, not published: with the 8 turns held, the existing MAS round wire whose MKF-computed DC resistance at 25 C (WindingOhmicLosses::calculate_dc_resistance_per_winding, real winding geometry: turns as laid plus the routed terminal leads) is nearest the published 26.0 mOhm typical; 'Round 0.2 - Grade 1' gives 26.55 mOhm (24.93 mOhm with the idealised winding, no leads). The winding's inductance is NOT used in the inference.
NOT published: numberTurns 8 and the coil cavity (D 2.1 mm height, E 3.5 mm OD, F 1.6 mm post) are the earlier corpus fixture's assumptions, kept unchanged.

STAND-IN: the published core material is only 'composite' (a molded metal-powder composite) with no permeability; MAS has no molded-composite material, so the FeSiAl powder 'Kool Mµ 125' stands in. Inductance computed with it is not a prediction of the real part.
